title: The Secret Doctrine of the Tarot
author: Paul Case
imprint: The Word, edited by H. W. Percival, New York, March 1916 to September 1917
publicDomain: Published in the US in 1916 and 1917: in the public domain there; Case died 1954.
note: Case's first writing on the Tarot, the twelve chapters printed in The Word from March 1916 to September 1917 (volumes 22, 23 and 25), set from the IAPSOP archive's scans of those volumes. Each page was read twice, by Mistral OCR and by Tesseract, and the two were compared word for word with each other and with the scans' own text; every difference was settled on the page image. The printer's spellings are kept as printed, as is the magazine's bold type for emphasis. The figures are cut from the same scans: the Tree of Life, the old Tarot's trumps beside Case's own redrawing of them, and his diagrams. The series stops at the tenth trump.
